sections.title: Archaeology of Sacrifice
sections.description: This course is introduces the practice of sacrifice among different ancient and historical contexts, incorporating archaeology, history, literature, and theology. Students will study archaeological site reports, historical texts, and material culture related to sacrifice, and consider the topic through different theoretical lenses. Over the course of the semester, there will be several visits to the Penn Museum galleries and collections to work with objects from the ancient Near East, Central America, South America, and the ancient Mediterranean. This course will contain images and discussions of sensitive topics, including human remains and death.
